# dokku_git_auth (Data Source)

Manages netrc credentials for a git host

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_git_auth" "example" {
  host = "github.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Git server hostname (e.g. github.com)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
